en: A monochrome panoramic photograph of a small village nestled in a valley with terraced hillsides rising behind it. The foreground shows fields and scattered houses, while the central area is a dense cluster of village buildings with tiled roofs. The mountains or high hills dominate the background. At the bottom margin, printed text identifies the view as a panorama of Vattaro in Trentino.
